title: CLIP WORKS
description: Bend wire into clips, sell them, grow the works. The engine's example, written as data.

items.label: AUTOCLIPPER
items.text: Bends a clip a second while there is wire on the bench.

items.label: MARKETING
items.text: Posters, then papers, then the radio. More people want clips at any price.

upgrades.label: Sharper dies
upgrades.text: Autoclippers bend half again as fast.

upgrades.label: Longer spools
upgrades.text: Each spool of wire runs 1,500 inches.

upgrades.label: A jingle
upgrades.text: Half again as many people want clips.

upgrades.label: Megaclippers
upgrades.text: Autoclippers bend three times as fast.

upgrades.label: A night shift
upgrades.text: The bench never stops. Autoclippers bend twice as much.

upgrades.label: The factory
upgrades.text: A building on the edge of town, full of benches. Autoclippers bend four times as much.

story.opening: CLIP WORKS. One bench, one spool of wire, and a hand-lettered sign: CLIPS 5¢.

beats.text: A hundred clips. The jar by the till is filling.
LETTER: The stationers on Fourth Street would like to stock your clips. All of them.
The wire merchant asks what we are doing with it all.
LETTER: A buyer from the capital. They have heard of us. Everyone has.
One million clips. Time to decide what the works is for.

endings.title: SELL THE WORKS
endings.text: A firm from the capital buys the bench, the dies and the name. You start again across town, and people remember you.

endings.title: HAND IT TO THE WORKERS
endings.text: The people who bent the clips own the works now. You start again across town, and people remember that too.

guide.title: MAKE A CLIP
guide.text: Tap the big button to bend an inch of wire into a clip. Clips sell on their own at the price you set.

guide.title: PRICE
guide.text: Cheaper clips sell faster; dearer ones earn more each. Find the price where the pile stays small.

guide.title: WIRE
guide.text: Every clip is an inch of wire. Buy a spool before the bench runs dry; its price moves.

guide.title: AUTOCLIPPERS
guide.text: An autoclipper bends a clip a second for you. Each costs a little more than the last.
